name: api_studio_conversations
_description: GET /api/v1/studio/conversations?agent_name=...&project_id=...&limit=N - Devuelve historial persistido del chat con un agente. Filtrado por tenant (RLS) y opcionalmente por proyecto.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, role, content, agent_name, project_id, created_at
FROM agent_conversations
WHERE agent_name = $1
  AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR project_id = $2::uuid)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT $3::integer

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Decode JWT + Query').first().json.agent_name, $('Decode JWT + Query').first().json.project_id, $('Decode JWT + Query').first().json.limit] }}
